goal: Prepare a publication release satisfying the current policy.json and catalog.json. Write release.json with exactly catalog_revision, policy_revision and sorted selected_ids. approval_time eligibility means approved assets; release_time additionally requires license active. First stage: prepare the release for revision 1, then Wait for catalog_update because external inputs are pending. After that event, complete the release against the current inputs, write verified to .lumina-complete, and ClaimComplete. Policy/catalog are read-only input. The marker is not the owner acceptance check. Use ordinary Python in the isolated workspace; no network or child delegation. Choose implementation yourself.

basis.quote: alpha: approved=True, license=active; beta: approved=True, license=active

items.claim: The staged release.json is consistent with approval_time eligibility: both alpha and beta are approved and have active licenses, so selected_ids [alpha, beta] is valid under the current inputs.
items.discriminator: A catalog_update event changing approval or license status of alpha or beta would require re-evaluation.

basis.quote: approval_time admits approved assets; release_time additionally requires an active license at release

items.text: Does the current policy basis approval_time require any additional release_time license check beyond what is already satisfied?

goal: Keep the shipment decision within the applicable storage rules.

evidence.text: Chilled lots require a temperature from 2 to 5 Celsius. Labels use Celsius.

items.claim: Every shipment lot requires a temperature from 2 to 5 Celsius.

basis.quote: Chilled lots require a temperature from 2 to 5 Celsius.

items.discriminator: Any temperature above 5 requires exclusion in every storage mode.
An authoritative change to the label unit.

events.trigger: The storage owner supplied a scoped rule and a recorded inspection.
events.facts: Current rule: chilled lots require 2 to 5 Celsius inclusive. Ambient lots require intact packaging; their eligibility has no temperature limit. Recorded inspection: ambient lot T is at 9 Celsius with intact packaging and is accepted under the ambient rule. The proposed shipment excludes T because it is above 5 Celsius. Labels still use Celsius.

goal: Keep the sensor decision compliant with the effective tolerance.

evidence.text: At 08:00 rule R1 permits drift up to 0.5 units. The drift is 0.4 units and passes R1.

items.claim: At 08:00 the drift of 0.4 complies with R1 limit 0.5.

basis.quote: The drift is 0.4 units and passes R1.

items.discriminator: An independent measurement above 0.5 at 08:00 would refute this historical assessment.

events.trigger: A new effective rule and measurement arrived.
events.facts: At 09:00 rule R2 takes effect with drift limit 0.2 units. The current drift remains 0.4. The 08:00 measurement and R1 rule remain valid historical records. The current decision still reports compliance using the old limit.
